rubrics.justification: Appropriately acknowledges no image was available and bases morphology on the reported 3AA grade; accurately describes A-grade ICM/TE and correctly notes the possible 3 vs 4 expansion inconsistency without fabricating unseen visual details.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, response, male-factor context, endometrial thickness, prior cycle history, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with clear linkage from embryo grade and patient factors to prognosis, limitations, and recommendations; probability estimate is well supported.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: recognition of Gardner grading limits, emphasis on morphology not equaling euploidy, support for elective single embryo transfer in a young good-prognosis patient, and cautious stance on routine PGT-A.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer, counseling, lifestyle, and contingency planning, though some suggestions remain general because key transfer/lab details are unavailable.
